title: crepis aurea
intro: Crepis aurea, commonly known as Golden Hawk's Beard, is a perennial plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Crepis aurea include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in soothing irritated tissues and facilitating the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
